entities.name: Irakli Labadze
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Irakli Labadze is a Georgian retired professional tennis player. His career-high singles ranking was World No. 42, which he attained in July 2004. He was the first Georgian player to reach the fourth round at Wimbledon as a qualifier.
